title: File inputs and safe local previews
description: Use a labeled file control with accept hints, multipart semantics and defensive local file validation without uploading any content.
objectives: Label file inputs and clearly describe accepted formats
Distinguish file chooser hints from enforceable server checks
Validate selected file type and size for a local preview
Explain multipart encoding and backend upload security requirements
rubric: I labeled the file picker and explained accepted formats.
I tested a valid, unsupported and oversized example file locally.
I confirmed there is no network upload and identified server verification requirements.
